label: Payments
description: The app books each payment of an order on a payment account in sevdesk, so invoices arrive as paid and refunds as paid out. sevdesk takes such bookings only on an account without a bank behind it: add a clearing account for your shop in sevdesk under Bank → Verrechnungskonto and enter its name here. Test connection lists the accounts it finds. A payment method that arrives elsewhere gets an exception below: another account, or no account to book nothing for it. No account is right for bank transfers, and for a PayPal account that is connected to sevdesk, which matches its imported transactions itself. Gift cards and store credit are booked only when they have an exception with an account. Leave everything empty to book nothing: invoices then stay open in sevdesk.

fields.label: sevdesk account for shop payments
fields.description: The account's name as it is written in sevdesk. Leave it empty to book nothing: invoices then stay open in sevdesk until you assign their payments there.
fields.placeholder: The account's name in sevdesk, for example: Online-Shop

fields.label: Payment method exceptions
fields.description: For payment methods that do not arrive on the account above. Leave a method's account empty to book nothing for it: that is right for bank transfers, and for a PayPal account that is connected to sevdesk, where sevdesk matches the imported transactions itself. Gift cards and store credit are booked only when they are listed here with an account.
